items.t: Automatic transmission failure on the RX300
items.job: Replace transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A used transmission costs less. Early slipping is sometimes helped by a fluid service or solenoid repair.

items.t: Engine oil sludge (oil gelling)
items.job: Remove valve covers and oil pan to clean out sludge
items.note: If sludge has already damaged the bearings, an engine replacement costs much more.

items.t: Floor carpet cover can hold the gas pedal down (recall)
items.job: Recall repair: trim or replace carpet cover and pedal
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Radiator can crack and leak coolant
items.note: A Lexus campaign covered affected 2004 models. Check your VIN or ask a dealer.

items.t: Dashboard cracks, turns shiny or gets sticky
items.note: Lexus had a warranty extension for this. Ask a dealer if it still applies. A dash cover costs far less.

items.t: Engine oil cooler hose can burst
items.job: Replace rubber oil cooler hose with metal line
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the engine ran low on oil.

items.t: VVT-i oil supply hose can rupture (campaign)
items.job: Replace rubber VVT-i oil hose with metal line
items.note: Free under a Lexus campaign. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the engine ran low on oil.

items.t: Floor mat can trap the gas pedal (recall)
items.job: Recall repair: reshape gas pedal and replace floor mats
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: ABS and stability control may not control one wheel properly (recall)
items.job: Reprogram ABS and stability control computer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Brake actuator fault turns off ABS and stability control (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Fuel delivery pipe can leak (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: ABS actuator seal problem (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Air bags may not deploy correctly (recalls)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: "Braking Power Low" warning at startup
items.note: Ask a Lexus dealer whether recall or warranty coverage applies to your VIN first.

items.t: Brake booster vacuum pump can fail (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Droning noise at light throttle
items.job: Install updated exhaust part per bulletin
items.note: Comfort fix only. A dealer may cover it under warranty on newer vehicles.

items.t: Hesitation or jerky shifts at low speed
AWD rear coupling noise
items.note: Some cases are fixed with a rear differential fluid change, which costs much less.

items.t: Chirping from the high-pressure fuel pump
items.note: The chirp is often normal. Replace the pump only if it is loud, rough-running or setting codes.

items.t: In-tank fuel pump can fail (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Passenger seat sensor can switch off the air bag (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Driver air bag may be disabled (recall)
items.job: Replace steering wheel spiral cable (clock spring)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Backup camera picture can fail (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Front steering knuckle may be weak (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer. Price is per side.

items.t: Oil leak from the timing chain cover
items.note: Labor heavy; many shops remove the engine to reach the cover.

items.t: Hybrid inverter can shut down the hybrid system (recalls)
items.note: Free under recall 11V-342 or 13V-396. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Crankshaft pulley can come loose and drop the drive belt (recall)
items.job: Replace crankshaft pulley and drive belt
items.note: Free under recall 11V-539. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Second-row center seat belt webbing may be damaged
items.job: Replace second-row center seat belt assembly
items.note: Free under recall 25V-059. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front head restraints can pull out without the release button
items.note: Free under recall 24V-482. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Shipping hook left on can damage the fuel filler pipe
items.note: Free under recall 21V-043. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front brakes groan or squeal
items.job: Replace front pads and rotors with updated hardware

items.t: Air conditioning compressor shaft seal can leak
items.job: Replace A/C compressor and recharge system
items.note: Leak test first; a seep may only need seals and a recharge.

items.t: Key is hard to turn in the ignition
